front: Bonjour, j'ai une réservation au nom de Martin.
pronunciation: [bohn-ZHOOR, zhay ün ray-zehr-vah-SYOHN oh nohn duh mar-TAN]
back: Hello, I have a reservation under the name Martin.
context: 'Au nom de' = under the name of.

front: Je voudrais une chambre double pour trois nuits.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo-dreh ün shahm-bruh DOO-bluh poor trwah NWEE]
back: I'd like a double room for three nights.

front: Vous avez encore des chambres disponibles ?
pronunciation: [voo zah-vay ahn-kor day shahm-bruh dees-poh-NEE-bluh]
back: Do you still have rooms available?

front: Désolé, l'hôtel est complet ce week-end.
pronunciation: [day-zoh-LAY, loh-tel eh kohm-PLEH suh wee-KEND]
back: Sorry, the hotel is fully booked this weekend.

front: Le petit-déjeuner est compris ?
pronunciation: [luh puh-tee day-zhuh-nay eh kohm-PREE]
back: Is breakfast included?

front: Le petit-déjeuner est servi de sept heures à dix heures.
pronunciation: [luh puh-tee day-zhuh-nay eh sehr-VEE duh seh TUHR ah dee ZUHR]
back: Breakfast is served from 7 to 10 a.m.

front: À quelle heure faut-il libérer la chambre ?
pronunciation: [ah kel uhr foh-teel lee-bay-ray lah SHAHM-bruh]
back: What time is check-out?
context: 'Libérer la chambre' = to vacate the room.

front: Voici votre clé, vous êtes au troisième étage.
pronunciation: [vwah-SEE voh-truh KLAY, voo zet oh trwah-zyem ay-TAZH]
back: Here's your key, you're on the third floor.
context: Many hotels now use 'une carte magnétique' (key card).

front: Il y a un ascenseur ?
pronunciation: [eel yah an nah-sahn-SUHR]
back: Is there an elevator?
context: Older hotels in France may not have one: worth asking!

front: Est-ce qu'il y a le wifi dans les chambres ?
pronunciation: [es-keel yah luh wee-FEE dahn lay SHAHM-bruh]
back: Is there Wi-Fi in the rooms?

front: Quel est le mot de passe du wifi ?
pronunciation: [kel eh luh moh duh PAS dü wee-FEE]
back: What's the Wi-Fi password?

front: La climatisation ne marche pas.
pronunciation: [lah klee-mah-tee-zah-SYOHN nuh marsh PAH]
back: The air conditioning isn't working.

front: Il n'y a pas d'eau chaude dans la salle de bain.
pronunciation: [eel nyah pah doh SHOHD dahn lah sal duh BAN]
back: There's no hot water in the bathroom.

front: Est-ce que je pourrais changer de chambre ?
pronunciation: [es-kuh zhuh poo-reh shahn-zhay duh SHAHM-bruh]
back: Could I change rooms?
context: 'Changer de' + noun without article: changer de chambre, de train.

front: La chambre donne sur la rue, c'est un peu bruyant.
pronunciation: [lah shahm-bruh dun sür lah RÜ, seh tan puh brwee-YAHN]
back: The room faces the street, it's a bit noisy.
context: 'Donner sur' = to look out onto. 'Bruyant' = noisy.

front: Je préférerais une chambre plus calme, côté cour.
pronunciation: [zhuh pray-fay-ruh-reh ün shahm-bruh plü KALM, koh-tay KOOR]
back: I'd prefer a quieter room, facing the courtyard.
context: 'Côté cour' = courtyard side (quieter); 'côté rue' = street side.

front: Pourriez-vous me réveiller à six heures ?
pronunciation: [poo-ryay-voo muh ray-veh-yay ah see ZUHR]
back: Could you wake me up at six?
context: Formal inversion with the conditional: very polite.

front: Je peux laisser mes bagages ici après le départ ?
pronunciation: [zhuh puh leh-say may bah-GAHZH ee-SEE ah-preh luh day-PAR]
back: Can I leave my luggage here after check-out?

front: La taxe de séjour n'est pas incluse dans le prix.
pronunciation: [lah taks duh say-ZHOOR neh pah zan-KLÜZ dahn luh PREE]
back: The tourist tax isn't included in the price.
context: French towns charge a small 'taxe de séjour' per night.

front: Je voudrais annuler ma réservation.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo-dreh ah-nü-lay mah ray-zehr-vah-SYOHN]
back: I'd like to cancel my reservation.

front: L'annulation est gratuite jusqu'à quarante-huit heures avant l'arrivée.
pronunciation: [lah-nü-lah-syohn eh grah-TWEET zhüs-kah kah-rahnt-wee TUHR ah-vahn lah-ree-VAY]
back: Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before arrival.

front: J'ai réservé sur internet, voici la confirmation.
pronunciation: [zhay ray-zehr-VAY sür an-tehr-NET, vwah-SEE lah kohn-feer-mah-SYOHN]
back: I booked online, here's the confirmation.

front: Vous pouvez me recommander un bon restaurant dans le quartier ?
pronunciation: [voo poo-vay muh ruh-koh-mahn-day an bohn res-toh-RAHN dahn luh kar-TYAY]
back: Can you recommend a good restaurant in the area?

front: Le parking de l'hôtel est payant.
pronunciation: [luh par-KEENG duh loh-tel eh peh-YAHN]
back: The hotel car park is paid.

front: Nous avons loué un gîte en Provence.
pronunciation: [noo zah-vohn loo-AY an ZHEET ahn proh-VAHNS]
back: We rented a holiday cottage in Provence.
context: 'Un gîte' = a rural holiday rental. 'Une chambre d'hôtes' = a B&B.

front: On a dormi dans une auberge de jeunesse.
pronunciation: [ohn nah dor-MEE dahn zün oh-behrzh duh zhuh-NES]
back: We slept in a youth hostel.

front: Le camping est complet en août.
pronunciation: [luh kahm-PEENG eh kohm-PLEH ahn NOOT]
back: The campsite is full in August.
context: 'Le camping' = campsite. August is peak season in France.

front: La réception est ouverte vingt-quatre heures sur vingt-quatre.
pronunciation: [lah ray-sep-SYOHN eh too-vehrt vant-kah-TRUHR sür vant-KAT-ruh]
back: Reception is open 24/7.

front: Pourriez-vous m'appeler un taxi pour demain matin ?
pronunciation: [poo-ryay-voo mah-puh-lay an tak-SEE poor duh-man mah-TAN]
back: Could you call me a taxi for tomorrow morning?

front: Je voudrais régler la note, s'il vous plaît.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo-dreh ray-glay lah NOT, seel voo PLEH]
back: I'd like to settle the bill, please.

front: Le minibar a été utilisé ?
pronunciation: [luh mee-nee-BAR ah ay-tay ü-tee-lee-ZAY]
back: Was the minibar used?

front: Votre séjour s'est bien passé ?
pronunciation: [voh-truh say-ZHOOR seh byan pah-SAY]
back: Did you enjoy your stay?

front: La vue sur la mer était magnifique.
pronunciation: [lah vü sür lah MEHR ay-teh mah-nyee-FEEK]
back: The sea view was magnificent.
context: 'La vue sur' = the view of. Imparfait for description.

front: Je vais laisser un avis positif sur le site.
pronunciation: [zhuh veh leh-say an nah-vee poh-zee-TEEF sür luh SEET]
back: I'm going to leave a positive review on the website.

front: Nous espérons vous revoir très bientôt !
pronunciation: [noo zes-pay-rohn voo ruh-vwahr treh byan-TOH]
back: We hope to see you again very soon!
